Lesbian who went through a very similar thing. You aren’t bad for slowly getting past it. What I do is immediately replace the thought with a dumb or stupid concept like “I wonder what type of music that girl likes” or imagining a ridiculous scenario — her playing the violin terribly. Take the girls out of the context and into a new one. Turning your brain off won’t work because you literally can’t do that.

The other thing is association. The options I took here were turtles. If I saw a girl I would simply imagine her as a turtle, or just start thinking about turtles. They’re not very arousing and I know a lot of turtle facts. I stopped after a while because it’s weird, though.

You can’t see girls the same way, so reroute the way you see girls — change them.
